comments.text: Some of these numbers look inflated. Exclude test accounts, anything with an @test.example.com email.
I care about margin, not revenue. Revenue growth on products we barely make money on is not good news.
Monthly is too coarse for me. Show trends weekly.
Skip the London coupon thing. That was a planned holiday promo, not a problem.
Rank findings by dollar impact so the biggest problems are at the top.
